title: 第14章 两个人的攻略第15章 深入废墟
content_zh:
第十四章 两个人的攻略
“我？”
听到罗德的说话，莉洁惊讶的睁大了眼睛，就连一旁的梅斯也诧异的张开了嘴巴。
众所周知，灵师在龙魂大陆中是近似于药师，医生和护士的职业，她们基本上都是团队内的辅助职业，为其他人包扎伤口，治愈伤势，释放护盾和驱逐毒素才是灵师最常做的事情。至于上前线战斗？这种事情恐怕听都没有听说过吧！
“没错。”
罗德点了点头，在踏入这里的那一瞬间，他仿佛又重新变成了那个率领团队刷本的指挥。
“一会儿你听从我的命令，这并不需要特别复杂的技巧，但是对你的反应和意识要求会会有些高，不过只要熟悉了，我想不会太难………你现在对于能量的掌握是……？神圣光辉能用几次？”
虽然通过之前莉洁的治愈法术，罗德大致猜到了她的等级，不过保险起见，还是确认下的好。
“我是一名正职灵师，属于外环七层。至于神圣光辉………一天只能够使用一次，一次可以维持一天……如果我的灵魂力量消耗不大的话。”
施术者的职业分级与战斗职业者不同，除了职业等级之外，他们还拥有对于灵魂力量的层次划分，分别是外环，中环，内环，其中外环十层，中环七层，内环三层。这是因为施法者相信他们的力量来源于自己的灵魂深处，而在普遍的观念中，灵魂被施法者视为三种相互融合的环状存在，一个施法者对于自己的灵魂探询的越深，他的力量就越强大。而莉洁的的实力已经到达了外环七层，这就意味着她极有可能突破外环施法者的极限，进入中环的行列。
对于一个六级灵师来说这可真是难得。不过这样一来，罗德就更有把握了。
“很好，多注意梅斯先生，如果有危险的话给他套个盾……明白了吗？”
“这个………我明白了，罗德先生。”
虽然罗德口中不时跳出一些让莉洁感到莫名其妙的单词，不过连猜带蒙她还是了解了对方的意思，于是微微点头表示明白。
“梅斯先生，我们的补给还够几天？”
“还够三，四天吧。”
抱着手中的旅行袋，胖商人想了一想随后回答过，不过他的面上却带着一丝悲壮。
“如果我们省着点吃的话……”
“趁现在减肥是个不错的机会。”
如果罗德说这句话的时候在笑的话，那么梅斯还可以把它当成一句玩笑，可惜不幸的是罗德的表情非常平静，没有任何笑意，这反而让胖商人更加纠结起来，他抱着旅行袋，还打算再说些什么时，罗德却已经转过头去，对着莉洁下达了命令。

“施展神圣光辉吧。”
“好的。”
面对罗德的命令，莉洁微一点头，随后，她伸出双手，闭上眼睛。
很快，一团柔和的光芒从少女的手心中央缓缓浮现，柔和的白色光辉向着四面八方扩散开来，不知道是不是错觉，胖商人发现周围那些原本近在身边的浓雾在照耀到这光辉之后，便开始飞快的后退，他揉了揉眼睛之后，却发现原本被浓雾所笼罩的四周，此刻已经清晰了许多。一些废墟本来只能够看见一个模糊大概的影子，但是现在却可以清楚的看见残缺的墙壁与房屋。这让众人不由的松了口气，毕竟无论如何，视线清楚一些总是比较保险的。
“我走第一个，莉洁跟上，梅斯先生你走到最后，不要离我们太远，无论发生什么事情，不要一个人行动。”
废墟之中一片寂静。
充满正能量的光辉驱散了浓雾，但是却并没有驱散内中蕴涵的危险。众人在罗德的带领下缓慢的前进，不时停下来观察四周，接着再继续前进———不过很快，罗德又摆了摆手，示意两人停下脚步。
如果他的记忆没有错，自己已经差不多接近第一波小怪的刷新地点了。
果然不出所料，就在罗德停下脚步之后没多久，前方的雾气中却是浮现出了数个微弱的光点，它们看起来一闪一闪的，仿佛眼睛一般。
“那，那是什么？”
梅斯一瞬间便立刻紧张了起来。
“是幽鬼。”
罗德伸出右手，很快，星痕便出现在了他的手中。
“小心一点，它们不敢太靠近的。”
罗德话音刚落，众人便看见眼前浓雾猛然一缩一涨，接着便吐出了三只怪异的生物。
它们看起来有人类的形态，但是全身上下都被浓密的雾气包裹，三只怪物站在一起，隐隐约约的甚至有些看不清楚它们的边界，只有那三对明亮的小眼睛才能够使人确认这并非只是单纯的雾气这么简单。
或许更不简单。
“莉洁，对第一只施展治愈之光。”
治愈之光？
听到这个命令，少女的脑中掠过一丝疑惑，那是治愈法术啊，为什么要对这种怪物施展？不过这个疑问也只在莉洁的脑中一闪而过，很快，莉洁就举起右手，对眼前的怪物施展出了治愈之光。

做为一个灵师，莉洁的技术还是非常不错的。治愈之光是一个中距离的治愈法术，只要能够确定目标的位置，那么施展它并不困难。对于莉洁而言更是轻松自如，只不过或许因为对方并非同伴，而是怪物的原因，使得少女的动作有些犹豫，不过她还是很快就完成了法术。
一道洁白的光流立刻从空中浮现，随后包裹在了幽鬼的身上。按照原本的效果，被它所包裹的生命会立刻恢复一定程度的伤势，甚至还可以让人振作起精神，属于灵师所使用的法术之中基础的基础。
但是幽鬼的表现却完全出乎了少女的意料之外，在被那道白色光辉笼罩的同时，幽鬼变发出了一声连她都可以听清楚的尖叫，接着它那原本站立的身体象被人打了一拳般重重的弯下腰去不断的颤抖着，包裹着它身体的迷雾甚至在那一瞬间分崩离析，宛如被阳光照耀到而融化的冰雪一般。这让莉洁不由的大吃一惊，她甚至下意识的低下头去望了望自己的双手，怎么也想不通自己是如何释放一个拥有如此杀伤力的法术的。
在看到幽鬼的表现之后罗德却是非常淡定，要知道治愈之光所产生的正能量本来就是幽鬼一类负能量集合体的克星，更不用说莉洁的血统中有一半是正统的天使血统，天使所凝结的正能量和普通人类所凝结的自然在质量上有所差异，如果说后者施放的正能量对幽鬼来说是滚烫的沸水的话，那么前者所凝结的正能量就不亚于高浓度硫酸，也幸亏莉洁只是个混血，如果她是一个纯粹天使的话，那么这只幽鬼早就灰飞烟灭了。
莉洁不明白为什么一个治愈法术会拥有这样的效果，但是事实上龙魂大陆中的玩家基本都很清楚，在他们看来，说是治愈之光只不过是穿了一个掩人耳目的马甲，这个法术的本质就是施放一道正能量。只不过正能量在遇到生命体时会带来治愈的效果，为了方便起见才这么称呼，并不代表它只能够治愈伤势。在龙魂大陆开服初期，在玩家中还曾经流传过一个笑话：一个亡灵法师最悲剧的事情是遇到一群亡灵———因为亡灵法师的法术基本上都是来自负能量，而用它们去攻击同样用负能量组成的不死生物只会起到治愈而非毁灭的效果。这也让不少曾经幻想操纵死亡大军争霸天下的亡灵法师玩家不得不泪流满面学习一些元素法术来确保自己对不死怪物的优势———对了，他们有时还必须兼职奶妈。
从本质上来说，亡灵法师和灵师没有太大的区别，他们大多生活在自己的能力无法对其造成伤害的群体环境中，只有遇到相反属性时才会产生作用。只不过对于亡灵法师来说，遇到生命体的机率相对高一些。而对于灵师来说，直到黑暗降临战争的中期，亡灵肆虐之时，她们才摆脱了后勤人员的帽子，成为了前方的一员猛将。在那之前，灵师能够遇到亡灵的概率很低，再加上NPC毕竟不象玩家知道那么多的信息，所以会墨守成规并不奇怪。
不过现在可不是墨守成规的时候。
“攻击后面两只！”
罗德身形一晃，冲向了前方的幽鬼，同时向莉洁下达了命令。
“是！”
或许是受到了眼前景象的鼓舞吧，莉洁的回答也是非常精神有力，很快，又有两道充沛的正能量光辉从天而降，分别落在了另外两只幽鬼的身上。柔和的光芒笼罩在它们身上，停滞了它们试图向前进攻的步伐。而趁这个机会，启动了影闪的罗德已然来到了第一只幽鬼的身前。
“———！”
受到正能量冲刷的幽鬼发出了尖啸，而眼前的罗德则成为了它们发泄怒气的目标。很快，前方那只幽鬼便猛然伸出半透明的爪子，“呼”的一声向罗德抓了过来。
虽然莉洁的力量削弱了它们的防御能力，但是攻击力却因此而提升不少，如果不小心应对的话，很有可能阴沟里翻船。
不过对于罗德而言当然是不会允许这种事情发生的。
他身形一错，堪堪避开了幽鬼伸出的长爪，接着手中的洁白剑刃猛的一转，直刺向前。
要害攻击！
星痕精准的击中了幽鬼那虚幻身体中唯一半实体的灵魂凝结物，这让本就在正能量光辉下痛苦不堪的幽鬼更是发出了一声哀号，它绝望的举起双爪，随后原本就已经濒临崩溃的身体彻底消失了形态，化为一堆浮尘消散而去。
而就在这时，另外两只幽鬼也攻了过来。
content_en:
Chapter 14 A strategy for two people
"Me?"
Hearing Rhodes' words, Li Jie opened her eyes wide in surprise, and even Metz opened her mouth in surprise.
As we all know, spiritual masters are similar to pharmacists, doctors and nurses in Dragon Soul Continent. They are basically auxiliary professions within the team. Bandaging wounds for others, healing injuries, releasing shields and expelling toxins are what spiritual masters do most often. As for fighting on the front lines? I’m afraid I’ve never heard of such a thing!
"That's right."
Rhodes nodded. The moment he stepped into this place, he seemed to have once again become the commander who led the team to refresh their base.
"You will follow my orders in a moment. This does not require particularly complicated skills, but it will require a bit of high reaction and consciousness on your part. But as long as you are familiar with it, I think it won't be too difficult... What is your current control over energy...? How many times can you use the sacred radiance?"
Although Rhodes roughly guessed Li Jie's level through her previous healing spell, it was better to confirm it just to be on the safe side.
"I am a full-time spiritual master, belonging to the seventh level of the outer ring. As for the sacred light... I can only use it once a day, and it can last for a whole day... if my soul power is not consumed too much."
The professional classification of spell casters is different from that of combat professionals. In addition to professional levels, they also have levels of soul power, which are the outer ring, the middle ring, and the inner ring. The outer ring has ten levels, the middle ring has seven levels, and the inner ring has three levels. This is because spellcasters believe that their power comes from the depths of their souls, and in the common concept, the soul is regarded by spellcasters as three kinds of ring-like existences that merge with each other. The deeper a spellcaster explores his own soul, the stronger his power. And Li Jie's strength has reached the seventh level of the outer ring, which means that she is very likely to break through the limits of the outer ring casters and enter the ranks of the middle ring.
This is really rare for a sixth-level spiritual master. But in this way, Rhodes will be more confident.
"Very well, pay more attention to Mr. Mace, and put a shield on him if there is danger... Do you understand?"
"This...I understand, Mr. Rhodes."
Although some words popped up in Rhodes' mouth from time to time that made Li Jie feel puzzled, she still understood what he meant by guessing, so she nodded slightly to express her understanding.
"Mr. Mace, how many days do we have enough supplies?"
"It's enough for three or four days."
Holding the travel bag in his hand, the fat businessman thought for a while and then answered, but there was a trace of sadness on his face.
"If we save some food..."
"Now is a good opportunity to lose weight."
If Rhodes was laughing when he said this, then Mace could still regard it as a joke. Unfortunately, Rhodes' expression was very calm without any smile, which only made the fat businessman even more confused. When he was holding the travel bag and was about to say something more, Rhodes had already turned his head and issued an order to Li Jie.
"Show the divine light."
"Okay."
Facing Rhodes' order, Li Jie nodded slightly, then stretched out her hands and closed her eyes.
Soon, a soft light slowly emerged from the center of the girl's palm, and the soft white light spread in all directions. I don't know if it was an illusion. The fat businessman noticed that the thick fog around him started to retreat quickly after it shone on this light. After he rubbed his eyes, he found that the surrounding area that was originally shrouded in thick fog was now much clearer. Some ruins could only be seen as a vague shadow, but now the incomplete walls and houses can be clearly seen. This made everyone feel relieved. After all, it is always safer to have a clear line of sight.
"I'll go first, Li Jie will follow, Mr. Metz, you goFinally, don't be too far away from us, no matter what happens, don't act alone. "
There was silence among the ruins.
The radiance full of positive energy dispelled the thick fog, but it did not dispel the danger contained within. The crowd moved forward slowly under the leadership of Rhodes, stopping from time to time to observe their surroundings, and then continued to move forward - but soon, Rhodes waved his hand again, signaling the two of them to stop.
If his memory was correct, he was almost close to the place where the first wave of mobs were spawned.
As expected, not long after Rhodes stopped, several faint light spots appeared in the fog in front of him. They looked like twinkling eyes.
"Then, what is that? "
Mace immediately became nervous for a moment.
"It's a ghost. "
Rhodes stretched out his right hand, and soon, Star Mark appeared in his hand.
"Be careful, they don't dare to get too close. "
As soon as Rhodes finished speaking, everyone saw the thick fog in front of them suddenly shrinking and swelling, and then spit out three weird creatures.
They look like human beings, but their entire bodies are wrapped in dense fog. The three monsters stand together, and their boundaries are even vaguely unclear. Only the three pairs of bright little eyes can make people confirm that this is not just a simple fog.
Perhaps even less simple.
"Li Jie, cast healing light on the first one. "
Healing light?
After hearing this order, a trace of doubt flashed through the girl's mind. That was a healing spell. Why should it be cast on such a monster? However, this question only flashed through Li Jie's mind. Soon, Li Jie raised her right hand and cast a healing light on the monster in front of her.
As a spiritual master, Li Jie's skills are still very good. Healing Light is a medium-range healing spell. It is not difficult to cast it as long as the target's location can be determined. For Li Jie, it was even more relaxed, but perhaps because the other party was not a companion, but a monster, the girl's movements were a little hesitant, but she still completed the spell quickly.
A stream of pure white light immediately emerged from the sky, and then wrapped around the ghost's body. According to the original effect, the life wrapped by it will immediately recover a certain degree of injury, and can even cheer up people's spirits. It is the basis of the spells used by spiritual masters.
But the performance of the ghost was completely beyond the girl's expectation. While being enveloped by the white light, the ghost let out a scream that even she could hear clearly. Then its standing body bent down as if it had been punched by someone and was trembling continuously. The mist surrounding its body even fell apart at that moment, like ice and snow melted by the sun. This shocked Li Jie. She even subconsciously lowered her head and looked at her hands. She couldn't figure out how she could release such a lethal spell.
After seeing the performance of the ghost, Rhodes was very calm. You must know that the positive energy generated by the healing light is the nemesis of negative energy collections such as the ghost. Not to mention that half of Li Jie's bloodline is the orthodox angel bloodline. The positive energy condensed by angels is the same as the natural condensed by ordinary humans. There is a difference in quality. If the positive energy cast by the latter is like scalding boiling water to the ghost, then the positive energy condensed by the former is no less than high-concentration sulfuric acid. Fortunately, Li Jie is only a hybrid. If she were a pure angel, then this ghost would have been wiped out long ago.
Li Jie doesn't understand why a healing spell has such an effect, but in fact, the players in Dragon Soul Continent basically know it. In their view, the healing light is just wearing a vest to hide the light. The essence of this spell is to cast aTao positive energy. It's just that positive energy will have a healing effect when it encounters a living body. It's called this for convenience, but it doesn't mean that it can only heal injuries. In the early days of the Dragon Soul Continent server, there was a joke among players: the most tragic thing for a necromancer is to encounter a group of undead - because the necromancer's spells basically come from negative energy, and using them to attack undead creatures that are also composed of negative energy will only have a healing rather than a destroying effect. This has also forced many necromancer players who once fantasized about controlling the army of death to conquer the world to learn some elemental spells in tears to ensure their advantage over undead monsters - by the way, they sometimes have to work part-time as wet nurses.
In essence, there is not much difference between necromancers and spiritual masters. Most of them live in a group environment where their own abilities cannot cause harm to them. They will only work when they encounter opposite attributes. It's just that for necromancers, the chance of encountering living creatures is relatively high. As for the spiritual masters, it was not until darkness fell in the middle of the war and the undead were raging that they got rid of the hat of logistics personnel and became a fierce general on the front line. Before that, the probability that a spiritual master would encounter the undead was very low. In addition, after all, NPCs did not know as much information as players, so it was not surprising that they would stick to the rules.
But now is not the time to stick to the rules.
"Attack the two at the back!"
Rhodes swayed and rushed towards the ghost in front, while giving orders to Li Jie.
"Yes!"
Perhaps inspired by the scene in front of her, Li Jie's answer was also very energetic. Soon, two more rays of abundant positive energy fell from the sky and fell on the other two ghosts respectively. A soft light enveloped them, halting their attempts to attack forward. Taking this opportunity, Rhodes, who activated Shadow Flash, had already arrived in front of the first ghost.
“————!”
The ghosts who were washed away by the positive energy screamed, and Rhodes in front of them became the target of their anger. Soon, the ghost in front suddenly stretched out its translucent claws and grabbed Rhodes with a "whoosh" sound.
Although Li Jie's power has weakened their defense capabilities, their attack power has increased a lot. If they are not handled carefully, they may capsize in the gutter.
But of course Rhodes would not allow this to happen.
He made a mistake and barely managed to avoid the long claws extended by the ghost, and then the white sword blade in his hand suddenly turned and stabbed forward.
Critical attack!
The star mark accurately hit the only semi-solid soul condensation in the ghost's illusory body, which made the ghost, which was already suffering under the light of positive energy, let out a wail. It raised its claws in despair, and then the body that was already on the verge of collapse completely disappeared and turned into a pile of floating dust and dissipated.
At this moment, two other ghosts also attacked.
